pr_title: Reading pull attachments should depend on read UnitTypePullRequests
pr_body:
Previously these would depend on read UnitTypeIssues.

Fixes #10336

issue_context.title: download of attachments is broken if internal issue management is disabled
issue_context.body:
- Gitea version (or commit ref): 1.11.x **as docker container**
- Git version: the version contained in https://hub.docker.com/r/gitea/gitea
- Operating system: Docker host is Debian 8
- Database (use `[x]`):
  - [ ] PostgreSQL
  - [x] MySQL
  - [ ] MSSQL
  - [ ] SQLite
- Can you reproduce the bug at https://try.gitea.io:
  - [x] Yes (provide example URL) : https://try.gitea.io/drahkrub/toast/pulls/1
  - [ ] No
  - [ ] Not relevant
- Log gist:

## Description

If internal issue management is disabled or an external issue management is used, than download of attachments (at least of attachments attached to pull requests) of the form "[ROOT_URL]/attachments/[:uuid]" produce a 404.

Can not be reproduced in 1.10.4, only in 1.11.0 and 1.11.1.

review_comments: Maybe the correct unitType (UnitTypePullRequests instead of UnitTypeIssues) is of interest here, too?!
don't have an issue to be able to check if it is a pull

and in any case if err is not nil then the unitType is not used: 

```go
repository, unitType, err := attach.LinkedRepository()
	if err != nil {
		ctx.ServerError("LinkedRepository", err)
		return
	}
```
